title: Repair bounded G12 custody cleanup and publication-size checks
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds a fixed-source successor for the shared P07/N22 G12 custody path. Seven raw-error ledgers move before local acquisition, retained pidfds receive an independent final release attempt after failed process observation, and the consumer requires exact integer publication size.

The package implements the three narrow repairs from a source-pinned ChatGPT Pro consultation and adds **41 synthetic source-function/window cases**, including **three retained allocation-failure counterexamples**, plus **94 separate byte/AST/diff checks** in normal and optimized Python. Selected AST-extracted helpers execute against descriptor/process tokens; the full target modules and original H25 caller are not imported or run.

**Partial source repair only.** The preflight ledger/snapshot/error-recording counterexamples, acquisition-to-registration gaps, full alias/schema review and actual source/mount/pin derivation remain open. No integrated source acceptance, N22/P07 body credit, adoption, complete caller qualification, gain, kappa or frontier change is claimed. Launch/handoff remain None. Original C01-C15 costs and unknown final tails remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6339](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6339).

Explicit user assignment: use the completed P07/G12 consultation package to repair the roadblock and submit scoped upstream work.

- Canonical base: `626e936ce4d61f2584316914fc71baf96940c512`.
- Public head: `abff67b31fa781e950c82d95eccb6f168950943c`.
- Reviewed/public tree: `ddfa9b7c84587a3a82f88692762a0ed887af7c4a`.
- Predecessors: #6321 at `ca9d90e93dc495e1e5e5ef6d271ff1e4f089cd0c`; proposed repair #6339 at `608ad23adc6c01264c8195daf7f18e29c17464a7`; fixed PR6029 lineage retained.
- Scope is **changed** from the retained portable-replay card to the explicitly assigned G12 source-custody repair. This is verification infrastructure for an authentic comparison, not a multiplication supplier.
- All 14 added files are under `research/h25-g12-custody-repairs/`. Exact PR6339 predecessor bytes are retained because its unmerged commit is not publication ancestry. All 84 consulted archive files are declared live byte-bound inputs for CI invalidation.
- Current all-state G12 search and the #1166 H25 handoff identify #6339 as the nearest repair; it does not address these three additional source issues. P02 and the independent #6316/#6317 packages are not expanded.

The detailed AI source review covers all 18 negative-branch categories and CP01-CP15 with conditional arguments, counterexamples and remaining gaps distinguished. Category coverage is not acceptance of each predicate.

## Validation

Executed locally on Python 3.12.3:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-custody-repairs --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-custody-repairs
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/h25-g12-custody-repairs
```

Metadata/pins and the registered normal/optimized replay pass. Each mode reports `source_cases=41 metadata_checks=94 unresolved_preflight_allocation=3 no_integrated_acceptance`. The committed-byte preflight checked 98 package/input files on the local reviewed commit; GitHub readback confirms the public tree equals that exact reviewed tree, with one parent commit and exactly 14 added files. The complete 146-line diff reproduces both corrected source files byte-for-byte in memory.

Controls exercise predecessor/new allocation boundaries, ordinary raw error ordering, persistent-denial P09 cleanup, ambiguous-close no-retry behavior, exact schema domains and the retained stronger-contract failures. No full target import, original H25/scientific/native invocation, provider acquisition, historical budget use or performance experiment occurred. The author's prior verifier was not replayed. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, with substantial OpenAI Codex implementation/verification assistance and ChatGPT Pro consultation assistance. Credit unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance for #6339, #6321 source/review contributors, #6029 and retained Douglas R. Colkitt circuit/network/native/verification lineage. Predecessor bytes and notices are unchanged; Apache-2.0.

The distinct consultation-agent review is preserved as bounded draft evidence. Neither AI agreement nor these finite controls establish independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

See `research/h25-g12-custody-repairs/TASK.json` and README.

1. Establish whether exception-safe acquisition/registration and raw error retention can meet the ORIGINAL allocation-failure contract; prove the interpreter/ownership boundary before building a larger journal. Current source counterexamples remain, and any extra guarantee must be explicit.
2. Freeze and independently review the complete corrected parent/consumer/authority/driver mount/pin derivation for N22 and P07. Actual custody/admission is a later separate gate.
3. Under separately authorized runtime conditions, assess the full caller, original controls, resources and complete costs. This PR does not transfer the historical allowance or require a new generic accounting API.
